title: Shut Up in the Pot
year_evidence: 扉に『PUBLISHED BY THE AMERICAN FOLK-LORE SOCIETY … 1924』、序文の署名に『April, 1924.』
text:
Simeon Falconer, Santa Cruz Mountains.

There was a very hard time, no food whatsoever could they get, so
Anansi him family well fear. So when Bredder Tiger and Bredder Tacoomah
go see him, he tell them for last three or four days his wife and
children didn’t eat bread. Say they will go back home and send him some
of ’em food, and the two go back from Nansi yard and just dodge him now
and hear his wife call, “Heah! dinner ready!” And Bredder Tiger and
Bredder Tacoomah go back to the house knock on the door. The wife open
the door and Anansi go right out of the house—’shamed! The wife give
them some of the food to eat and it was only fresh beef.

They come back to Bredder Anansi now and Nansi tell them say, “I will
get the beef, but whatever I tell you to do, you mus’ be sure to do
it.” An’ he put on a big pot of water on fire, an’ him, Nansi, get into
the pot of water and gwine tell them shut him up in him pot. An’ tell
them as soon as him knock the pot, open the pot. An’ him come out now,
tell Bredder Tiger he mus’ get in the pot,—Tacoomah long side in the
pot too. And shut them up, an’ he get a heavy weight an’ put it on the
pot top. An’ he went right outside and tell him wife mus’ shove up the
fire, mak the fire bigger an’ bigger. An’ when him come back, them was
properly cooked. They gwine eat now, he was tuning up his fiddle—

   “I got them now! I got them now!
    Them think they got me, but I got them now!”
paragraphs: There was a very hard time, no food whatsoever could they get, so Anansi him family well fear. So when Bredder Tiger and Bredder Tacoomah go see him, he tell them for last three or four days his wife and children didn’t eat bread. Say they will go back home and send him some of ’em food, and the two go back from Nansi yard and just dodge him now and hear his wife call, “Heah! dinner ready!” And Bredder Tiger and Bredder Tacoomah go back to the house knock on the door. The wife open the door and Anansi go right out of the house—’shamed! The wife give them some of the food to eat and it was only fresh beef.

They come back to Bredder Anansi now and Nansi tell them say, “I will get the beef, but whatever I tell you to do, you mus’ be sure to do it.” An’ he put on a big pot of water on fire, an’ him, Nansi, get into the pot of water and gwine tell them shut him up in him pot. An’ tell them as soon as him knock the pot, open the pot. An’ him come out now, tell Bredder Tiger he mus’ get in the pot,—Tacoomah long side in the pot too. And shut them up, an’ he get a heavy weight an’ put it on the pot top. An’ he went right outside and tell him wife mus’ shove up the fire, mak the fire bigger an’ bigger. An’ when him come back, them was properly cooked. They gwine eat now, he was tuning up his fiddle—
“I got them now! I got them now! Them think they got me, but I got them now!”
語り手 シメオン・フォークナー(サンタクルス山地)

たいそうひもじい時世で、食べ物が何ひとつ手に入らず、アナンシの一家はすっかり怯えていた。そこで虎どんとタクーマどんが見舞いに行くと、アナンシは、この三、四日、女房も子どもたちもパン一つ口にしていないと言った。二人は、家へ帰って食べ物を少し送ってやろうと言って、アナンシの庭から引き返したが、ちょっと身を隠してみると、アナンシの女房が「ほら! 夕飯ができたよ!」と呼ぶのが聞こえた。虎どんとタクーマどんが家へ引き返して戸を叩くと、女房が戸を開け、アナンシは恥ずかしくて家から飛び出していった! 女房は二人に食べ物を出してくれたが、それは新しい牛肉ばかりだった。

二人がアナンシのところへ戻ってくると、アナンシはこう言った。「おれが牛肉を手に入れてやる。だがおれの言うとおりに、必ずしてくれよ」。そして大鍋に水を入れて火にかけ、アナンシ自身がその湯の鍋に入って、鍋に蓋をして閉じ込めろと言った。そして自分が鍋を叩いたらすぐ開けろと言った。そして出てくると、虎どんに鍋に入れと言い、タクーマもいっしょに鍋に入れた。そして蓋をして、重い石を鍋の上に載せた。それから外へ出て、女房に火を強くしろ、もっともっと大きくしろと言った。そして戻ってくると、二人はすっかり煮上がっていた。さあ食べようというとき、アナンシはヴァイオリンの調子を合わせながら歌った——
「とうとう手に入れたぞ! とうとう手に入れたぞ! やつらはおれを手に入れたつもりだったが、おれのほうが手に入れたぞ!」
